text.en:
The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include the
7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.
SEc. 3. This Order shall take effect five days from the
date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of February,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
